items.title: golden hour
items.blurb: We hiked up in the dark for this one. Cold hands, one long unbroken take, completely worth it.

items.title: night drive
items.blurb: Shot entirely after midnight with one synth track on repeat. Slept till two the next day.

items.title: portraits on film
items.blurb: A slow portrait series. Natural light, one roll each, no do-overs. That's the fun part.

items.title: the coast at dusk
items.blurb: Long exposures in the last twenty minutes of light. You get one window and that's it.

items.title: the long way home
items.blurb: Two lanes, one summer. A little road documentary about everything in between.

items.title: first dance
items.blurb: A wedding film that keeps the shaky, happy, real parts in. Those are the good bits.

items.title: dune lines
items.blurb: Wind-drawn geometry, about an hour after sunrise. The wind redraws it daily.

items.title: verse / chorus
items.blurb: A one-location music video. Practical light and hard cuts right on the beat.

items.title: high country
items.blurb: An alpine study. Cold hands again. I'm sensing a pattern.
